digest.component_or_area: Cloud JiraConfig validation and config schema
propositions: JiraConfig accepts non-https http:// URLs without validation, risking credential exposure in cleartext transit, while DC's ReconcilerConfig rejects them
Cloud's config consumers (resolve_jira_settings, _jira_onboard._detect, write_jira_config) swallow ConfigError exceptions, silently bypassing scheme validation
JiraConfig must gain a __post_init__ that validates url scheme (https-only) and an allow_insecure boolean override with matching environment variable coercion
write_jira_config must reject non-https urls with fail-loud behavior before persisting, preventing the onboarding wizard from silently writing cleartext credentials
resolve_jira_settings must re-raise InsecureUrlError before its existing ConfigError degradation, achieving parity with DC's fail-loud posture while preserving env fallback for genuine parse errors
